groups.summary: Substring host check in gitAuthArgs leaks service token to lookalike hosts
groups.reason: In src/git-auth.ts, gitAuthArgs decides whether to add the `Authorization: Bearer` header with `remoteUrl.includes("github.com")`. In src/worktree.ts, cloneRepo just passes repo.remoteUrl and SERVICE_TOKEN to gitAuthArgs and has no host check of its own. So I0001-02 is the same flaw as I0001-01, seen from the caller. Changing gitAuthArgs to parse the URL and compare the exact hostname fixes both tickets. Severity is Critical because anyone who can register a repository can steal the service token.
